note: validateCertificate(d) returns only { validityClass, underlyingCause, coronerReferralIndicated } — no rules array and no flags — so this is a SPLIT engine: the oracle pins detectFlaggedIssues(state) as expected.flaggedIssues with flagsArgs ["state"], mirroring form-app.js's `detectFlaggedIssues(state)` (the grader result is not passed to the detector). Classification is first-match: coronerReferralIndicated (referredToCoroner === 'yes' OR coronerReason in the 8-entry CORONER_REASONS list) -> 'refer-to-coroner'; missingPartIa OR unacceptableSoleCause (exactly one Part I line, Part II empty, and that line normalises to a listed mode of death) -> 'incomplete'; else 'valid'. underlyingCause is the lowest completed Part I line (I(c) else I(b) else I(a)), trimmed. Quirks verified: (1) coronerReason 'other' (labelled 'Other reportable circumstance') is NOT in CORONER_REASONS, so it never triggers referral; (2) the referral predicate and the medical-examiner flag are asymmetric — referral fires on coronerReason alone, but F-MEDICAL-EXAMINER-SCRUTINY-001 is suppressed only by referredToCoroner === 'yes', so a certificate with referredToCoroner 'no' + a listed coronerReason raises BOTH the coroner flag and the ME-scrutiny flag; (3) a mode-of-death text on I(b) with I(a) empty is both the sole cause and an illogical sequence, so three separate flags fire from one line; (4) referredToCoroner '' (unanswered) behaves exactly like 'no'. Flags are stable-sorted high > medium > low, insertion order within a tier: coroner, sole-cause, missing-I(a), illogical, ME-scrutiny, missing-interval, incomplete-certifier. The 'timestamp' key is added by form-app.js, not the grader. Regenerate expected with: bin/test-personas medical-certificate-of-cause-of-death --update

personas.name: Valid certificate, scrutinised by medical examiner
personas.description: Expected hospital death of an 84-year-old woman from bronchopneumonia due to a left MCA infarct due to atrial fibrillation, Part II type 2 diabetes; all three Part I intervals recorded; consultant certifier fully identified who attended the deceased; not referred to the coroner (reason 'none'); medical examiner status 'scrutinised'. Expect validityClass 'valid', underlyingCause 'Atrial fibrillation' (the I(c) line), coronerReferralIndicated false, and an empty flaggedIssues array (the ME-scrutiny flag is suppressed by 'scrutinised').

personas.name: Industrial disease referral asserted by reason alone
personas.description: Death of a 71-year-old retired shipyard lagger from malignant pleural mesothelioma. The certifier answered referredToCoroner 'no' but selected coronerReason 'industrial-disease', which is in CORONER_REASONS, so referral is indicated by the reason alone; medical examiner status 'pending'; the I(b) interval was left blank. Expect validityClass 'refer-to-coroner' (takes precedence over completeness), underlyingCause 'Occupational asbestos exposure' (I(b) is the lowest completed line since I(c) is empty), coronerReferralIndicated true, and three flags in order: F-CORONER-REFERRAL-REQUIRED-001 (high, description embeds '(Industrial disease or occupational exposure)'), F-MEDICAL-EXAMINER-SCRUTINY-001 (medium — fires because referredToCoroner !== 'yes', despite the referral being indicated), F-MISSING-INTERVAL-001 (low, 'I(b)').

personas.name: Night-shift draft: mode of death only, Part I(a) missing
personas.description: Foundation doctor's overnight draft for a 67-year-old man: Part I(a) left blank, Part I(b) reads 'Cardiac arrest' (a listed mode of death) with no interval, I(c) and Part II empty; coroner and medical-examiner questions unanswered; certifier name given but grade, GMC reference and attendance blank. Not referred (referredToCoroner '' and coronerReason '' both fail the referral predicate). Expect validityClass 'incomplete' (missingPartIa true AND unacceptableSoleCause true — one line, Part II empty, normalises to 'cardiac arrest'), underlyingCause 'Cardiac arrest', coronerReferralIndicated false, and six flags in order: F-UNACCEPTABLE-SOLE-CAUSE-001 (high), F-MISSING-PART-I-001 (high), F-ILLOGICAL-SEQUENCE-001 (medium: I(b) completed while I(a) empty), F-MEDICAL-EXAMINER-SCRUTINY-001 (medium), F-MISSING-INTERVAL-001 (low, 'I(b)'), F-INCOMPLETE-CERTIFIER-001 (low: 'grade, GMC reference, attendance on the deceased not recorded').
